name: io.github.layergen/eodly-mcp
description: Read your team's end-of-day reports and roster from Eodly. Sign in with OAuth or use an API key.

environmentVariables.name: EODLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An Eodly API key (eodly_sk_...). Create one in the Eodly app under Settings > Developer > API keys.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by an Eodly API key (eodly_sk_...), created in the app under Settings > Developer > API keys.
